description: Digues, barrages et bassins écrêteurs en gestion SMIAGE is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Mixte Inondations, Aménagement et Gestion de l'Eau Maralpin. SMIAGE is the manager of classified public safety works. The Pôle Ouvrages Hydrauliques manages the flood protection works transferred or delegated to it by the EPCIs under Decree "Digues" No. 2015-526 of 12 May 2015. Coverage: Syndicat Mixte Inondations, Aménagement et Gestion de l'Eau Maralpin. The portal shows the English title as "Digues, dams and catchment areas in management SMIAGE" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Mixte Inondations, Aménagement et Gestion de l'Eau Maralpin. Its keywords include inondation, ouvrage, ouvrage-de-protection, digue, securite-publique. The listing shows 3 download or service links in OGC:WFS, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
